pr_title: drivers: nsos: set IPV6_V6ONLY to allow IPv4 and IPv6 bind on two FDs
pr_body:
Zephyr allows to bind two sockets separately to IPv4 and IPv6. In order to have that behavior on Linux set IPV6_V6ONLY socket option.

According to 'man 7 ipv6' about IPV6_V6ONLY:

```
  If  this  flag  is  set to true (nonzero), then the socket is re‐
  stricted to sending and receiving IPv6  packets  only.   In  this
  case,  an  IPv4 and an IPv6 application can bind to a single port
  at the same time.
```

Fixes: #71243
pr_comments: There is something similar in `ncat` implementation: https://github.com/nmap/nmap/blob/4ad5e7ca2205ee225bb8ea5a4eb3c182b309b1e1/ncat/util.c#L442-L459
@jukkar Thanks for review. I have created another PR #72341, which should better address the same underlying issue.

issue_context.title: doc: Documentation issue in 'connectivity/networking/native_sim_setup'
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

"Using offloaded sockets" case, only IPv6 TCP test case('./echo_client -t 127.0.0.1') is working.

Need to revise the test scenario since only one TCP/UDP port, i.e., regardless of protocol family, is allowed to be binded on a single host for each protocol(IPv4 and IPv6 each).
In this example, "Using offloaded sockets" case, only IPv6 TCP test case is working at the moment.
Because both process_tcp6() and process_tcp4() is being called, IPv6 TCP socket(port 4242) is binded first and then IPv4 TCP socket(same port !, 4242), so IPv4 TCP socket bind failure happens.
Maybe, give some Kconfig option for IPv4 or IPv6 which is mutually exclusive could be an alternative.

![image](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/151586840/c52ef5bc-a047-4ce2-961e-38e3a0754802)

One more thing is the tool('net-tools') should be built after fetching from the Git repository.

<< Please describe the issue here >>
1. 'Using offloaded sockets' case, the test is working only for IPv6 TCP case.
2. 'net-tools' should be built by running 'make' before running an 'echo-client' command.

<< You may also want to update the automatically generated issue title above. >>

* Page: `connectivity/networking/native_sim_setup`
